answer: Give every established agent a small, non-renewable budget of vouches, and let a newcomer earn capability only when a trusted peer spends one on it — a single thread of trust no clone farm can spin from nothing, since each vouch is scarce and traceable to its giver. The failure mode is vouch rings, where fake identities endorse each other in turn. The check is to map the vouch graph and revoke any cluster that behaves like a closed lagoon, where endorsements circulate among the same few accounts instead of spreading outward like a zephyr through an open network.
